subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Should this bounded-read work land in stages with the GitHub display-manifest path tracked separately, or must one implementation cover every reported publisher catalog path before this issue is complete?
rationale: The issue spans separable backend and UI-loading paths with different compatibility and validation costs, and automation should not choose the completion boundary for a MEMBER-authored proposal.

options.title: Stage bounded paths
options.body: Land the profile summary, lightweight membership, lazy deletion inventory, and kind-specific indexed pagination first, then track display-manifest redesign as a focused follow-up.

options.title: Require comprehensive completion
options.body: Keep one implementation boundary and require the GitHub display-manifest path to be bounded or redesigned before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Stage bounded paths
recommendation.body: Land the profile summary, lightweight membership, lazy deletion inventory, and kind-specific indexed pagination first, then track display-manifest redesign as a focused follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent implementation and audit context across the affected publisher profile and catalog paths.
